digest.component_or_area: CI linting and code quality gates
propositions: scripts/ directory (41 files) is currently excluded from make lint and make typecheck, leaving 78 ruff check violations and 7 formatter violations undetected

12 RUF100 (unused-noqa), 11 E501 (line-too-long), 2 RUF005 (collection-concat), 2 RUF059 (unused-unpack), 1 B905 (zip-without-strict), and 1 RUF036 (none-not-at-end-of-union) violations must be fixed before enrolling scripts/ in the lint gate

50 T201 (print) violations across 10 files must be exempted by consolidating nine per-file entries into a single "scripts/**" = ["T201"] entry, and all 28 inline noqa: T201 directives must be deleted in the same change to prevent new RUF100 violations

Seven CI-blocking gate scripts (check_verify_gate_parity.py, check_comment_hygiene.py, check_raw_git_writes.py, check_wall_clock_asserts.py, gen_env_registry.py, check_docs_index.py, check_readme_quickstart.py) are themselves ungated and invoked by _build-and-test.yml
Five RUF100 directives referencing non-enabled rules (PLC0415, S603, S310, PLR0915) must be confirmed to document no live intent before deletion
scripts/ must be added to Makefile sources variable to make it lint-scoped, with ruff check and ruff format both passing
